from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Literal
from uuid import UUID, uuid4

from pydantic import TypeAdapter
from sqlalchemy import and_, delete, func, or_, select, update
from sqlalchemy.dialects.postgresql import insert
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.models.conversation import ChatConversation, ChatMessage, ChatOwnerStatus, ChatTurn
from app.repositories.memory_repository import MemoryRepository
from app.schemas.conversation import ConversationEntry

_ENTRY = TypeAdapter(ConversationEntry)
_CONTEXT_KEYS = {
    "productStyle",
    "consultationParent",
    "ownedLook",
    "compound",
    "schemaVersion",
    "currentGoal",
    "product",
    "style",
    "styleCandidates",
    "styleConditions",
    "pendingGoal",
    "memoryRevocationEpoch",
    "memoryRefs",
}
_FORBIDDEN = {
    "authorization",
    "sessiontoken",
    "sessionid",
    "resultsetid",
    "faceimage",
    "facevideo",
    "accesstoken",
    "refreshtoken",
    "chatcontext",
    "token",
    "session",
    "apikey",
    "password",
    "secret",
    "prompt",
    "rawtoolresult",
    "image",
    "imagedata",
    "imagebase64",
    "video",
    "videoframe",
}
_DISPLAY_KEYS = {
    "consultation",
    "ownedLookOptions",
    "compound",
    "appliedMemories",
    "products",
    "styleCandidates",
    "styleRecipe",
    "optionSearch",
    "ingredientResults",
    "evidence",
    "knowledge",
    "ingredientComparison",
    "fragranceSearchSummary",
    "resultType",
    "styleStatus",
    "styleContext",
    "styleConditions",
    "resultContext",
}


def _check_safe(value: object) -> None:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, item in value.items():
            if not isinstance(key, str) or key.replace("_", "").lower() in _FORBIDDEN:
                raise ValueError("Sensitive or invalid field in persistent data")
            _check_safe(item)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            _check_safe(item)


def _check_display(value: dict) -> None:
    if set(value) - _DISPLAY_KEYS:
        raise ValueError("Unknown display field")
    _check_safe(value)


class ConversationRepository:
    """All writes participate in the caller's transaction and never commit independently."""

    def __init__(self, session: AsyncSession) -> None:
        self.session = session

    async def ensure_active_owner(self, owner_id: str) -> bool:
        await self.session.execute(
            insert(ChatOwnerStatus).values(owner_id=owner_id).on_conflict_do_nothing()
        )
        status = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatOwnerStatus.status)
            .where(ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == owner_id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
        return status == "ACTIVE"

    async def get(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> ChatConversation | None:
        return await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatConversation)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
        )

    async def list(self, owner_id: str, limit: int = 20) -> list[ChatConversation]:
        rows = await self.session.scalars(
            select(ChatConversation)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
            .order_by(ChatConversation.updated_at.desc(), ChatConversation.id.desc())
            .limit(limit)
        )
        return list(rows)

    async def list_page(
        self, owner_id: str, limit: int, before: tuple[datetime, UUID] | None = None
    ) -> list[ChatConversation]:
        stmt = (
            select(ChatConversation)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
        )
        if before:
            stmt = stmt.where(
                or_(
                    ChatConversation.updated_at < before[0],
                    and_(ChatConversation.updated_at == before[0], ChatConversation.id < before[1]),
                )
            )
        rows = await self.session.scalars(
            stmt.order_by(ChatConversation.updated_at.desc(), ChatConversation.id.desc()).limit(
                limit
            )
        )
        return list(rows)

    async def first_user_messages(
        self, owner_id: str, conversation_ids: list[UUID]
    ) -> dict[UUID, str]:
        if not conversation_ids:
            return {}
        first_text = (
            select(ChatMessage.text)
            .where(ChatMessage.conversation_id == ChatConversation.id, ChatMessage.role == "user")
            .order_by(ChatMessage.sequence)
            .limit(1)
            .correlate(ChatConversation)
            .scalar_subquery()
        )
        rows = await self.session.execute(
            select(ChatConversation.id, first_text)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id.in_(conversation_ids),
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
                ChatConversation.subject_json["type"].astext == "general",
            )
        )
        return {room_id: text for room_id, text in rows if text is not None}

    async def get_creation(self, owner_id: str, request_id: UUID) -> ChatTurn | None:
        return await self.session.get(ChatTurn, (owner_id, request_id))

    async def _creation_for_room(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> ChatTurn | None:
        return await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatTurn).where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.operation == "conversation_create",
                ChatTurn.result_resource_id == conversation_id,
            )
        )

    async def room_deletion_completed(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> bool:
        creation = await self._creation_for_room(owner_id, conversation_id)
        return creation is not None and creation.result_payload == {"roomDeletionComplete": True}

    async def room_chat_request_ids(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> list[UUID]:
        return list(
            await self.session.scalars(
                select(ChatTurn.request_id).where(
                    ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                    ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                    ChatTurn.operation == "chat",
                )
            )
        )

    async def record_creation(
        self, owner_id: str, request_id: UUID, fingerprint: str, conversation_id: UUID
    ) -> None:
        self.session.add(
            ChatTurn(
                owner_id=owner_id,
                request_id=request_id,
                operation="conversation_create",
                fingerprint=fingerprint,
                status="COMMITTED",
                result_resource_id=conversation_id,
                result_version=0,
            )
        )
        await self.session.flush()

    async def create(
        self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, thread_id: UUID, subject: dict
    ) -> ChatConversation | None:
        validated = _ENTRY.validate_python(subject).model_dump(
            mode="json", by_alias=True, exclude_none=True
        )
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return None
        row = ChatConversation(
            id=conversation_id, owner_id=owner_id, thread_id=thread_id, subject_json=validated
        )
        self.session.add(row)
        await self.session.flush()
        return row

    async def update_context(
        self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, expected_version: int, context: dict
    ) -> int | None:
        if set(context) - _CONTEXT_KEYS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown conversation context field")
        _check_safe(context)
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return None
        result = await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatConversation)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatConversation.conversation_version == expected_version,
            )
            .values(
                context_json=context,
                conversation_version=expected_version + 1,
                updated_at=func.now(),
            )
            .returning(ChatConversation.conversation_version)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none()

    async def add_message(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, message: ChatMessage) -> bool:
        _check_display(message.display_payload or {})
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id) or not await self.get(
            owner_id, conversation_id
        ):
            return False
        if message.conversation_id != conversation_id:
            raise ValueError("Message conversation mismatch")
        self.session.add(message)
        await self.session.flush()
        return True

    async def messages(
        self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, limit: int = 50
    ) -> list[ChatMessage]:
        rows = await self.session.scalars(
            select(ChatMessage)
            .join(ChatConversation, ChatConversation.id == ChatMessage.conversation_id)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
            .order_by(ChatMessage.sequence)
            .limit(limit)
        )
        return list(rows)

    async def recent_messages(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> list[ChatMessage]:
        rows = await self.session.scalars(
            select(ChatMessage)
            .join(ChatConversation, ChatConversation.id == ChatMessage.conversation_id)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .join(
                ChatTurn,
                and_(
                    ChatTurn.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id,
                    ChatTurn.conversation_id == ChatMessage.conversation_id,
                    ChatTurn.request_id == ChatMessage.request_id,
                    ChatTurn.status == "COMMITTED",
                ),
            )
            .where(
                ChatMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
            .order_by(ChatMessage.sequence.desc())
            .limit(8)
        )
        return list(reversed(list(rows)))

    async def message_page(
        self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, limit: int, before: int | None = None
    ) -> list[ChatMessage]:
        stmt = (
            select(ChatMessage)
            .join(ChatConversation, ChatConversation.id == ChatMessage.conversation_id)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
        )
        if before is not None:
            stmt = stmt.where(ChatMessage.sequence < before)
        rows = await self.session.scalars(stmt.order_by(ChatMessage.sequence.desc()).limit(limit))
        return list(rows)

    async def last_sequence(self, conversation_id: UUID) -> int:
        return int(
            (
                await self.session.scalar(
                    select(func.max(ChatMessage.sequence)).where(
                        ChatMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id
                    )
                )
            )
            or 0
        )

    async def response_message(
        self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, message_id: UUID
    ) -> ChatMessage | None:
        return await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatMessage)
            .join(ChatConversation, ChatConversation.id == ChatMessage.conversation_id)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatMessage.id == message_id,
                ChatMessage.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
        )

    async def reserve_turn(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        conversation_id: UUID,
        request_id: UUID,
        fingerprint: str,
        base_version: int,
        lease_until: datetime,
        operation: Literal["chat", "state_update"] = "chat",
    ) -> bool:
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return False
        room = await self.get(owner_id, conversation_id)
        if room is None or room.conversation_version != base_version:
            return False
        stmt = (
            insert(ChatTurn)
            .values(
                owner_id=owner_id,
                request_id=request_id,
                conversation_id=conversation_id,
                operation=operation,
                fingerprint=fingerprint,
                fingerprint_schema=2,
                status="IN_PROGRESS",
                base_version=base_version,
                lease_until=lease_until,
            )
            .on_conflict_do_nothing()
            .returning(ChatTurn.request_id)
        )
        return (await self.session.scalar(stmt)) is not None

    async def get_turn(self, owner_id: str, request_id: UUID) -> ChatTurn | None:
        turn = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatTurn)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatTurn.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
        )
        if turn and turn.conversation_id and not await self.get(owner_id, turn.conversation_id):
            return None
        return turn

    async def expire_turn(self, owner_id: str, request_id: UUID) -> bool:
        result = await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.lease_until <= func.clock_timestamp(),
            )
            .values(status="INTERRUPTED", updated_at=func.now(), error_code="lease_expired")
            .returning(ChatTurn.request_id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none() is not None

    async def expire_room_turns(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> None:
        await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.lease_until <= func.clock_timestamp(),
            )
            .values(status="INTERRUPTED", updated_at=func.now(), error_code="lease_expired")
        )

    async def cancel_turn(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID, request_id: UUID):
        # Match finish_turn's owner -> room -> turn lock order. The winner is durable.
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return None
        room = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatConversation)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if room is None:
            return None
        turn = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.operation == "chat",
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if turn is None:
            return None
        if turn.status == "IN_PROGRESS":
            turn.status = "INTERRUPTED"
            turn.error_code = "user_cancelled"
            turn.updated_at = datetime.now(UTC)
        return {
            "requestId": str(request_id),
            "status": turn.status,
            "conversationVersion": room.conversation_version,
        }

    async def execution_active(self, owner_id, conversation_id, request_id, base_version):
        return bool(
            await self.session.scalar(
                select(ChatTurn.request_id)
                .join(ChatConversation, ChatConversation.id == ChatTurn.conversation_id)
                .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatTurn.owner_id)
                .where(
                    ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                    ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                    ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                    ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                    ChatTurn.lease_until > func.clock_timestamp(),
                    ChatTurn.base_version == base_version,
                    ChatConversation.conversation_version == base_version,
                    ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                    ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
                )
            )
        )

    async def interrupt_turn(self, owner_id: str, request_id: UUID, attempt: int) -> None:
        await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.attempt_count == attempt,
            )
            .values(status="INTERRUPTED", updated_at=func.now(), error_code="execution_uncertain")
        )

    async def fail_turn(
        self, owner_id: str, request_id: UUID, attempt: int, error_code: str
    ) -> None:
        await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.attempt_count == attempt,
                ChatTurn.lease_until > func.clock_timestamp(),
            )
            .values(status="FAILED", updated_at=func.now(), error_code=error_code[:64])
        )

    async def renew_turn(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        conversation_id: UUID,
        request_id: UUID,
        attempt: int,
        lease_until: datetime,
    ) -> bool:
        active = (
            select(ChatConversation.id)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
            )
            .exists()
        )
        result = await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.attempt_count == attempt,
                ChatTurn.lease_until > func.clock_timestamp(),
                active,
            )
            .values(lease_until=lease_until, updated_at=func.now())
            .returning(ChatTurn.request_id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none() is not None

    async def finish_turn(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        conversation_id: UUID,
        request_id: UUID,
        turn_id: UUID,
        attempt: int,
        base_version: int,
        context: dict,
        messages: list[ChatMessage],
        checkpoint_id: str | None = None,
        memory_epoch: int | None = None,
        memory_refs: list[dict] | None = None,
        memory_generation: str | None = None,
        memory_enabled: bool = False,
    ) -> bool:
        if set(context) - _CONTEXT_KEYS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown conversation context field")
        _check_safe(context)
        if len(messages) != 2 or [item.role for item in messages] != ["user", "assistant"]:
            raise ValueError("A completed turn requires a user and an assistant message")
        for message in messages:
            _check_display(message.display_payload or {})
            if message.conversation_id != conversation_id:
                raise ValueError("Message conversation mismatch")
            if message.request_id not in (None, request_id):
                raise ValueError("Message request mismatch")
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return False
        if memory_epoch is not None:
            current_epoch = await self.session.scalar(
                select(ChatOwnerStatus.revocation_epoch).where(ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == owner_id)
            )
            if current_epoch != memory_epoch:
                return False
        if memory_generation is not None and (
            await MemoryRepository(self.session).generation(owner_id, memory_enabled)
            != memory_generation
        ):
            return False
        room = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatConversation)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatConversation.conversation_version == base_version,
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if room is None:
            return False
        turn = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatTurn.operation == "chat",
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.base_version == base_version,
                ChatTurn.attempt_count == attempt,
                ChatTurn.lease_until > func.clock_timestamp(),
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if turn is None:
            return False
        room.context_json = context
        room.conversation_version += 1
        room.accepted_checkpoint_id = checkpoint_id
        room.accepted_checkpoint_version = room.conversation_version if checkpoint_id else None
        room.updated_at = func.now()
        turn.status = "COMMITTED"
        turn.committed_version = room.conversation_version
        turn.turn_id = turn_id
        turn.response_message_id = messages[1].id
        turn.updated_at = func.now()
        for message in messages:
            message.request_id = request_id
            message.memory_refs = memory_refs or []
        self.session.add_all(messages)
        await self.session.flush()
        return True

    async def finish_state_update(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        conversation_id: UUID,
        request_id: UUID,
        attempt: int,
        base_version: int,
        context: dict,
        memory_epoch: int | None = None,
        memory_generation: str | None = None,
        memory_enabled: bool = False,
    ) -> dict | None:
        if set(context) - _CONTEXT_KEYS:
            raise ValueError("Unknown conversation context field")
        _check_safe(context)
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return None
        if memory_epoch is not None:
            current_epoch = await self.session.scalar(
                select(ChatOwnerStatus.revocation_epoch).where(ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == owner_id)
            )
            if current_epoch != memory_epoch:
                return None
        if memory_generation is not None and (
            await MemoryRepository(self.session).generation(owner_id, memory_enabled)
            != memory_generation
        ):
            return None
        room = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatConversation)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
                ChatConversation.conversation_version == base_version,
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if room is None:
            return None
        turn = await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatTurn)
            .where(
                ChatTurn.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatTurn.request_id == request_id,
                ChatTurn.conversation_id == conversation_id,
                ChatTurn.operation == "state_update",
                ChatTurn.status == "IN_PROGRESS",
                ChatTurn.base_version == base_version,
                ChatTurn.attempt_count == attempt,
                ChatTurn.lease_until > func.clock_timestamp(),
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if turn is None:
            return None
        snapshot = {
            "conversationId": str(conversation_id),
            "conversationVersion": base_version + 1,
            "context": context,
        }
        _check_safe(snapshot)
        room.context_json = context
        room.conversation_version = base_version + 1
        room.updated_at = func.now()
        turn.status = "COMMITTED"
        turn.committed_version = base_version + 1
        turn.result_version = base_version + 1
        turn.result_resource_id = conversation_id
        turn.result_payload = snapshot
        turn.updated_at = func.now()
        await self.session.flush()
        return snapshot

    async def finish_reply(
        self,
        owner_id: str,
        conversation_id: UUID,
        request_id: UUID,
        turn_id: UUID,
        attempt: int,
        base_version: int,
        context: dict,
        question: str,
        answer: str,
        display: dict,
        checkpoint_id: str | None = None,
        memory_epoch: int | None = None,
        memory_refs: list[dict] | None = None,
        memory_generation: str | None = None,
        memory_enabled: bool = False,
    ) -> bool:
        sequence = await self.last_sequence(conversation_id)
        return await self.finish_turn(
            owner_id,
            conversation_id,
            request_id,
            turn_id,
            attempt,
            base_version,
            context,
            [
                ChatMessage(
                    id=uuid4(),
                    conversation_id=conversation_id,
                    sequence=sequence + 1,
                    role="user",
                    text=question,
                    display_payload={},
                ),
                ChatMessage(
                    id=uuid4(),
                    conversation_id=conversation_id,
                    sequence=sequence + 2,
                    role="assistant",
                    text=answer,
                    display_payload=display,
                ),
            ],
            checkpoint_id,
            memory_epoch,
            memory_refs,
            memory_generation,
            memory_enabled,
        )

    async def mark_deleted(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> bool:
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return False
        result = await self.session.execute(
            update(ChatConversation)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_(None),
            )
            .values(deleted_at=func.now(), updated_at=func.now())
            .returning(ChatConversation.id)
        )
        return result.scalar_one_or_none() is not None

    async def deleting_thread(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> UUID | None:
        return await self.session.scalar(
            select(ChatConversation.thread_id)
            .join(ChatOwnerStatus, ChatOwnerStatus.owner_id == ChatConversation.owner_id)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatOwnerStatus.status == "ACTIVE",
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_not(None),
            )
        )

    async def purge_deleted(self, owner_id: str, conversation_id: UUID) -> bool:
        if not await self.ensure_active_owner(owner_id):
            return False
        result = await self.session.execute(
            delete(ChatConversation)
            .where(
                ChatConversation.id == conversation_id,
                ChatConversation.owner_id == owner_id,
                ChatConversation.deleted_at.is_not(None),
            )
            .returning(ChatConversation.id)
        )
        if result.scalar_one_or_none() is None:
            return False
        creation = await self._creation_for_room(owner_id, conversation_id)
        if creation is not None:
            creation.result_payload = {"roomDeletionComplete": True}
        return True

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_recent_messages(self) -> Self:
        ids = [m.id for m in self.recent_messages]
        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or sum(len(m.text) for m in self.recent_messages) > 8000:
            raise ValueError("Invalid recent conversation")
        looks = [(item.kind, item.look_id) for item in self.previous_style_candidates]
        if len(looks) != len(set(looks)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate previous looks")
        slots = [item.slot for item in self.style_conditions or []]
        if len(slots) != len(set(slots)):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate style conditions")
        return self

    general_makeup: bool = Field(default=False, strict=True, exclude_if=lambda v: not v)
    message: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=1000)
    locale: Locale = "en"
    skin: SkinHint | None = None
    request_type: Literal[
        "chat", "ar_command", "beauty_consultation", "style_consultation", "knowledge_consultation"
    ] = "chat"
    chat_context: BeautyContext | None = None
    request_id: UUID | None = None
    conversation_id: UUID | None = None
    expected_conversation_version: Annotated[int, Field(strict=True, ge=0, le=2**53 - 1)] | None = (
        None
    )
    ar_context: ArContext | None = None
    screen_context: ScreenContext | None = None
    style_context: StyleContext | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def ignore_ar_fields_for_chat(cls, data):
        # Older chat clients could send unrecognized fields; keep them inert.
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            return data
        request_type = data.get("requestType", data.get("request_type", "chat"))
        g2_enabled = data.get("locale", "en") == "ko" and get_settings().g1_supervisor_enabled
        style_search = data.get("styleSearch", data.get("style_search")) is True
        if (
            not g2_enabled or request_type not in {"chat", "beauty_consultation"}
        ) and not style_search:
            ignored = {"clarificationId", "clarification_id"}
            if not (
                g2_enabled
                and get_settings().g5_enabled
                and request_type == "knowledge_consultation"
            ):
                ignored.update({"recentMessages", "recent_messages"})
            data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k not in ignored}
        if data.get("generalMakeup", data.get("general_makeup")) is True and not g2_enabled:
            # The app used to omit context for these requests; preserve that OFF contract.
            data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k not in {"chatContext", "chat_context"}}
        session_chat = request_type in {"chat", "knowledge_consultation"} and g2_enabled
        if request_type != "beauty_consultation" and not session_chat:
            data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k not in {"chatContext", "chat_context"}}
        if isinstance(data, dict) and request_type in {"chat", "knowledge_consultation"}:
            ar_fields = {"requestId", "request_id", "arContext", "ar_context"}
            if session_chat or data.get("conversationId", data.get("conversation_id")) is not None:
                ar_fields = {"arContext", "ar_context"}
            data = {k: v for k, v in data.items() if k not in ar_fields}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def validate_ar_request(self) -> Self:
        if self.conversation_id is not None:
            if self.request_type == "ar_command":
                raise ValueError("AR commands do not support persistent conversations")
            if self.request_id is None or self.expected_conversation_version is None:
                raise ValueError("Persistent chat requires a request ID and expected version")
        if self.style_search and self.request_type not in {"chat", "style_consultation"}:
            raise ValueError("Style search is only available in chat")
        if self.excluded_style and (not self.style_search or self.previous_style_candidates):
            raise ValueError("Look exclusion requires a new style search")
        if (
            self.previous_style_candidates or self.previous_style_selection
        ) and not self.style_search:
            raise ValueError("Previous look references require style search")
        if self.style_compare and (not self.style_search or not self.previous_style_candidates):
            raise ValueError("Style comparison requires previous candidates")
        if self.request_type == "ar_command" and (
            self.request_id is None or self.ar_context is None or not self.message.strip()
        ):
            raise ValueError("AR commands require a request ID, context, and non-blank message")
        return self

class VerifiedOption(CompoundModel):
    candidate: RankedOption
    outcome: Literal["eligible", "excluded", "unknown", "failed"]
    verification: OptionCandidate | None = None
    reason: str | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def match_option(self) -> Self:
        if self.verification:
            v = self.verification
            if (v.product_id, v.option_id) != (self.candidate.product_id, self.candidate.option_id):
                raise ValueError("Mismatched option evidence")
            expected = {"ELIGIBLE": "eligible", "EXCLUDED": "excluded", "REFERENCE_ONLY": "unknown"}
            if self.outcome != expected[v.group] and not (
                self.outcome == "failed" and v.group == "REFERENCE_ONLY"
            ):
                raise ValueError("Verdict contradicts catalog evidence")
        elif self.outcome in {"eligible", "excluded"}:
            raise ValueError("Decisive verdict requires option evidence")
        return self

class ConsultationParent(ParentModel):
    schema_version: Literal[1] = 1
    plan_id: UUID = Field(default_factory=uuid4)
    version: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    # Existing five-task bound is retained; roles may repeat with distinct task IDs.
    tasks: list[ParentTask] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=5)
    question: ParentQuestion | None = None
    pending_questions: list[ParentQuestion] = Field(default_factory=list)
    result_selection: ResultSelection | None = None
    look: StyleContext | None = None
    execution_state: Literal["active", "cancelled"] = "active"

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def coherent(self):
        if len({t.task_id for t in self.tasks}) != len(self.tasks):
            raise ValueError("Duplicate parent task ID")
        if any(t.version > self.version for t in self.tasks):
            raise ValueError("Future task revision")
        if self.question and self.question.version != self.version:
            raise ValueError("Stale question revision")
        if any(
            q.version != self.version or q.task_id not in {t.task_id for t in self.tasks}
            for q in self.pending_questions
        ):
            raise ValueError("Stale or unowned pending question")
        selection = self.result_selection
        if selection and (
            selection.version != self.version
            or len(set(selection.task_ids)) != len(selection.task_ids)
            or set(selection.task_ids) - {t.task_id for t in self.tasks}
            or (
                selection.selected_task_id is not None
                and selection.selected_task_id not in selection.task_ids
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError("Invalid display selection")
        return self

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from pydantic.alias_generators import to_camel

from app.schemas.catalog import OptionSearchResponse, PriceBasis, SearchIngredient
from app.schemas.owned_look_intent import LookReferenceSnapshot
from app.schemas.style_recipe import LookKind, Zone


class OwnershipDeclaration(BaseModel):
    source: Literal["user"] = "user"
    status: Literal["missing", "present"]
    quote: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)
    confirmed_current: bool = False
    # Old records have no evidence that an exact option was shown to the user.
    scope: Literal["legacy", "zone", "product", "option"] = "legacy"


class OwnedLookFilters(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")

    source: Literal["user"] = "user"
    max_price_krw: int | None = Field(default=None, alias="maxPriceKRW", ge=0, le=100_000_000)
    ingredient_conditions: list[SearchIngredient] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=6)
    fragrance_free: bool = False
    price_basis: PriceBasis = "collected_snapshot"
    unsupported: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=8)


class OwnedLookContext(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")

    kind: LookKind
    look_id: str
    recipe_version: str
    version: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    # Closed Zone enum naturally bounds this map to nine areas.
    declarations: dict[Zone, OwnershipDeclaration] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    # Keys are bounded by the current recipe, pruned on every execution.
    item_declarations: dict[str, OwnershipDeclaration] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    # Exemptions suppress only the inherited zone rule, not verified inventory.
    exceptions: dict[str, Zone] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    product_declarations: dict[str, OwnershipDeclaration] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    references: LookReferenceSnapshot | None = None
    filters: OwnedLookFilters = Field(default_factory=OwnedLookFilters)


class OwnedLookOptionRef(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")

    product_id: str
    shade_id: str | None = None
    option_id: str
    product_name: str
    brand: str
    shade_name: str


class OwnedLookOptionDisplay(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")

    selections: list[OwnedLookOptionRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
    batches: list[OptionSearchResponse] = Field(default_factory=list)
    failed_product_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class OwnedLookOutcomeItem(BaseModel):
    """Final resolution of one listed product/option, not a claim it is mandatory."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")

    need_id: str
    zone: Zone
    label: str
    status: Literal[
        "owned", "recommended", "ownership_unknown", "evidence_missing", "excluded", "lookup_failed"
    ]


class OwnedLookOutcome(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")

    status: Literal["completed", "partial", "waiting_user", "failed"]
    items: list[OwnedLookOutcomeItem] = Field(default_factory=list)

"""Validated proposals for conversation-scoped ownership changes, never capabilities."""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from pydantic.alias_generators import to_camel

from app.schemas.style_recipe import Zone


class ReferenceModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")


class LookReferenceTarget(ReferenceModel):
    target_id: str
    product_id: str
    option_id: str | None = None
    shade_id: str | None = None
    label: str
    zone: Zone


class LookReferenceSnapshot(ReferenceModel):
    recipe_version: str
    version: str
    targets: list[LookReferenceTarget] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # Preserve actual display positions, including unresolved entries.
    look_products: list[str | None] = Field(default_factory=list)
    recommendations: list[str | None] = Field(default_factory=list)


class LookReferenceOperation(ReferenceModel):
    action: Literal["declare", "exempt"]
    target_id: str
    scope: Literal["product", "option"]
    status: Literal["present", "missing"] | None = None


class OwnedLookIntent(ReferenceModel):
    snapshot_version: str
    action: Literal["update", "clarify"]
    operations: list[LookReferenceOperation] = Field(default_factory=list)
    question: str = ""

class ProductStyleContext(BaseModel):

"""Internal Supervisor contracts; never authorize writes or claim app execution."""

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field
from pydantic.alias_generators import to_camel

from app.schemas.catalog import BaseProductType
from app.schemas.consultation_task import ProductRequirementChange
from app.schemas.style_recipe import StyleContext

ToolName = Literal["beauty", "graph_chat", "ar_command", "style", "knowledge"]


class SupervisorModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(alias_generator=to_camel, populate_by_name=True, extra="forbid")


class IngredientComparison(SupervisorModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(serialize_by_alias=True)

    current_product_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    target_product_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=128)
    current_shade_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)
    target_shade_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)
    awaiting: Literal["current", "target"]


class ScreenContext(SupervisorModel):
    option_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)
    ingredient_comparison: IngredientComparison | None = Field(
        default=None, exclude_if=lambda value: value is None
    )
    screen_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=64)
    product_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)
    shade_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)
    look_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)
    style_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=128)


class ResolvedContext(SupervisorModel):
    style: StyleContext | None = None
    message: str
    request_type: str
    screen: ScreenContext | None = None
    candidate_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    selected_product_id: str | None = None
    selected_shade_id: str | None = None
    ar_state_version: int | None = None
    has_beauty_context: bool = False
    has_ar_context: bool = False
    # Caller IDs are references, not catalog facts or server-owned sessions.
    trusted: Literal[False] = False
    session_version: int | None = None
    result_set_id: str | None = None
    state_source: Literal["client_hint", "server_session"] = "client_hint"


class IngredientPlanCondition(SupervisorModel):
    ingredient_name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)
    operator: Literal["includes", "excludes"]


class SearchPlan(SupervisorModel):
    product_requirement: ProductRequirementChange | None = None
    product_type: BaseProductType | None = Field(default=None, exclude_if=lambda v: v is None)
    option_search: bool = Field(default=False, exclude_if=lambda v: not v)
    price_basis: Literal["current_offer", "catalog_reference", "collected_snapshot"] | None = Field(
        default=None, exclude_if=lambda v: v is None
    )
    intent: Literal["search", "refine", "detail", "price", "general"]
    scope: Literal["catalog", "previous"] = "catalog"
    selection: Literal["lowest_price"] | None = None
    category: Literal["lip", "cheek", "eye", "base", "skincare", "suncare"] | None = None
    max_price_krw: int | None = Field(
        default=None, alias="maxPriceKRW", strict=True, ge=0, le=100_000_000
    )
    fragrance_free: bool | None = None
    moisturizing: bool | None = None
    texture: Literal["matte"] | None = None
    unsupported_conditions: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=8)
    query: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=80)
    ordinal: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=1, le=6)
    ingredient_name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=500)
    ingredient_operator: Literal["includes", "excludes"] = "includes"
    ingredient_lookup: bool = False
    persist_ingredient_conditions: bool = Field(default=False, strict=True)
    ingredient_conditions: list[IngredientPlanCondition] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=6)
    shade_name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=128)
    compare_ordinals: list[int] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=2)
    clear_filters: list[
        Literal[
            "category",
            "productType",
            "maxPriceKRW",
            "fragranceFree",
            "moisturizing",
            "query",
            "ingredientConditions",
            "texture",
        ]
    ] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=8)


class IntentDecision(SupervisorModel):
    intent: Literal["product", "ingredient", "general", "style", "ar", "compound", "knowledge"]
    request_type_hint: str
    slots: SearchPlan | None = None


class Sufficiency(SupervisorModel):
    ready: bool
    missing: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class TaskPlan(SupervisorModel):
    tasks: list[ToolName] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=2)
    stop_reason: str | None = None
    stop_on_error: Literal[True] = True


class ConditionCheck(SupervisorModel):
    condition: str
    verdict: Literal["MATCH", "NOT_MATCH", "UNKNOWN", "ERROR"]
    product_id: str | None = None
    reason: str | None = None
    shade_id: str | None = None
    evidence_id: str | None = None


class EvidenceRef(SupervisorModel):
    product_id: str
    shade_id: str | None = None
    source: Literal["catalog_api", "neo4j"]
    verification: Literal["verified", "partial", "unknown"]
    reason: str | None = None
    evidence_id: str | None = None


class ToolResult(SupervisorModel):
    tool: ToolName
    status: Literal["success", "partial", "unsupported", "clarification", "error"]
    product_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    evidence: list[EvidenceRef] = Field(default_factory=list)
    conditions: list[ConditionCheck] = Field(default_factory=list)
    reason: str | None = None
    action_proposed: bool = False
    # Only the app can establish actual application; receiving a proposal is not ACK.
    application: Literal["not_requested", "awaiting_app_ack"] = "not_requested"


class SupervisorResult(SupervisorModel):
    intent: IntentDecision
    plan: TaskPlan
    result: ToolResult
    unavailable_tools: list[ToolName] = Field(default_factory=lambda: ["knowledge"])

def _context(filters, ids, now, *, scope_ids=None, selected=None, shades=None):
    return BeautyContext(
        issued_at=now,
        filters=filters,
        candidate_ids=ids,
        scope_ids=ids if scope_ids is None else scope_ids,
        selected_product_id=selected,
        shade_selections=shades or {},
    )


def _reply(answer, context, products=(), result_type="clarification", *, preserve_selection=False):
    context.shade_selections = {
        pid: sid
        for pid, sid in context.shade_selections.items()
        if pid in context.candidate_ids
        or (preserve_selection and pid == context.selected_product_id)
    }
    if not preserve_selection and context.selected_product_id not in context.candidate_ids:
        context.selected_product_id = None
    checks = []
    for product in products:
        if context.filters.texture:
            checks.append(
                ConditionCheck(
                    condition="texture",
                    product_id=product.id,
                    verdict="MATCH" if product.texture == context.filters.texture else "UNKNOWN",
                    reason="product_catalog_metadata_not_option_verification",
                )
            )
        if context.filters.category:
            checks.append(
                ConditionCheck(
                    condition="category",
                    product_id=product.id,
                    verdict="MATCH"
                    if product.category == context.filters.category
                    else "NOT_MATCH",
                )
            )
        if context.filters.max_price_krw is not None:
            checks.append(
                ConditionCheck(
                    condition="maxPriceKRW",
                    product_id=product.id,
                    verdict="UNKNOWN"
                    if context.filters.option_search or product.price_krw <= 0
                    else (
                        "MATCH"
                        if product.price_krw <= context.filters.max_price_krw
                        else "NOT_MATCH"
                    ),
                )
            )
    return ChatResponse(
        answer=answer,
        products=[
            ProductRef(id=p.id, brand=p.brand, name=p.name, category=p.category) for p in products
        ],
        tool_result=ToolResult(
            tool="beauty",
            status="clarification"
            if result_type == "clarification"
            else ("partial" if context.filters.fragrance_free else "success"),
            product_ids=[p.id for p in products],
            evidence=[
                EvidenceRef(
                    product_id=p.id,
                    source="catalog_api",
                    verification="partial",
                    reason="full_ingredients_unavailable",
                )
                for p in products
            ],
            conditions=checks
            + (
                [
                    ConditionCheck(
                        condition="fragranceFree",
                        verdict="UNKNOWN",
                        reason="fragrance_free_evidence_unavailable",
                    )
                ]
                if context.filters.fragrance_free
                else []
            ),
        ),
        chat_context=context,
        result_type=result_type,
        evidence=[
            ProductEvidence(
                product_id=p.id, ingredient_coverage="key_only" if p.key_ingredients else "unknown"
            )
            for p in products
        ],
    )


def _matches(product: CatalogProduct, filters: BeautyFilters, *, identity_only=False) -> bool:
    if filters.texture and product.texture != filters.texture:
        return False
    # The current Catalog contract provides keyIngredients, not verified full ingredients.
    if filters.fragrance_free:
        return False
    if filters.category and product.category != filters.category:
        return False
    if filters.max_price_krw is not None and (
        product.price_krw <= 0 or product.price_krw > filters.max_price_krw
    ):
        return False
    if filters.query:
        if identity_only:
            return _matches_product_name(product, filters.query)
        source = " ".join(
            [
                product.brand,
                product.name,
                product.name_ko,
                product.description,
                *product.key_ingredients,
            ]
        ).casefold()
        if not all(word in source for word in filters.query.casefold().split()):
            return False
    return True


def _search_matches(products, filters, *, identity_only):
    products = list(products)
    if identity_only and filters.query:
        # A catalog brand named in a look query must match the brand field.
        query = _shade_label(filters.query)
        brands = {_shade_label(p.brand) for p in products if p.brand.strip()}
        required_brand = max(
            (brand for brand in brands if re.search(rf"(?<!\w){re.escape(brand)}(?!\w)", query)),
            key=lambda brand: (len(brand), brand),
            default=None,
        )
        if required_brand:
            products = [p for p in products if _shade_label(p.brand) == required_brand]
    return [p for p in products if _matches(p, filters, identity_only=identity_only)]


def _moisture_rank(product):
    text = " ".join([product.description, *product.tags]).casefold()
    return bool(re.search(r"촉촉|보습|hydrat|moisturi|保湿", text))


_COMPARE = re.compile(
    r"비교|차이|\bcompar(?:e|ison)\b|\bdiffer(?:s|ent|ence|ences)?\b|比較|違い|对比|比较|区别", re.I
)
COMPARISON_SCREENS = ("product-comparison", "product-ingredient-comparison")
_INGREDIENT_TOPIC = re.compile(r"성분|향료|\bingredients?\b|\bfragrance\b|成分|香料", re.I)
_REFERENCE_ONLY = re.compile(
    r"(?:다른|이|그|저)\s*(?:상품|제품)|(?:another|other"
    r"|this|that) product|他の商品|この商品|其他产品|这款",
    re.I,
)
