def units(s):
    return len(s.encode("utf-16-le")) // 2


def cut(s, a, z):
    raw = s.encode("utf-16-le")
    if not 0 <= a <= z <= len(raw) // 2:
        raise ValueError("Invalid source coordinate")
    return raw[a * 2 : z * 2].decode("utf-16-le")


def boundary(s, offset):
    raw = s.encode("utf-16-le")
    current = int.from_bytes(raw[2 * offset : 2 * offset + 2], "little")
    return offset - 1 if 0xDC00 <= current <= 0xDFFF else offset


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def tokenizer():
    return tiktoken.get_encoding("cl100k_base")


def tokens(value):
    return len(tokenizer().encode(value, disallowed_special=()))


def verify_selection(rows, bank):
    evidence, locations, rejected = [], [], 0
    for row in rows:
        try:
            source = bank[row["candidate_id"]]
            quote = row["exact_quote"]
            if source.document_id != row["document_id"] or not quote.strip() or len(quote) > 1800:
                raise ValueError("Invalid evidence identity")
            matches = set()
            block_order = row["paragraph"]
            locator = None
            for segment in source.segments:
                span = segment.span
                if (
                    span.block_order != block_order
                    or span.start_utf16 < 0
                    or span.end_utf16 - span.start_utf16 != units(segment.text)
                ):
                    continue
                for match in re.finditer(re.escape(quote), segment.text):
                    a = span.start_utf16 + units(segment.text[: match.start()])
                    matches.add((a, a + units(quote)))
                    locator = span.source_locator
            if len(matches) != 1 or locator is None:
                raise ValueError("Invalid evidence text")
            a, z = matches.pop()
        except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError):
            rejected += 1
            continue
        if any(
            e.document_id == source.document_id
            and e.block_order == block_order
            and max(a, e.start_utf16) < min(z, e.end_utf16)
            for e in evidence
        ):
            continue
        ref = f"E{len(evidence) + 1}"
        if len(evidence) >= 8 or (
            tokens(f"[{ref}] {quote}\n\n")
            + sum(tokens(f"[{e.id}] {e.quote}\n\n") for e in evidence)
            > CONTEXT_BUDGET
        ):
            continue
        location = Location(
            document_id=source.document_id,
            extraction_id=source.extraction_id,
            source_version=source.source_version,
            block_order=block_order,
            chunk_id=source.chunk_id,
            start_utf16=a,
            end_utf16=z,
        )
        locations.append(location)
        evidence.append(
            KnowledgeEvidence(
                **location.model_dump(exclude={"extraction_id"}),
                id=ref,
                title=source.title,
                source_file_id=source.source_file_id,
                source_locator=locator,
                quote=quote,
                relevance=row["relevance"],
            )
        )
    return evidence, locations, rejected


def boosts(ref, neighbors):
    blocks = {b.block_order: b for b in neighbors.blocks}
    p, a, z = ref.block_order, ref.start_utf16, ref.end_utf16
    block = blocks[p]
    raw = block.text
    if (
        len(blocks) != len(neighbors.blocks)
        or cut(raw, a, z) != ref.quote
        or block.source_locator != ref.source_locator
    ):
        raise ValueError("Original quote mismatch")
    points = [0, *[units(raw[: m.end()]) for m in _SENT.finditer(raw)], units(raw)]
    before = boundary(raw, max(a - 360, max((n for n in points if n < a), default=0)))
    after = boundary(raw, min(z + 420, min((n for n in points if n > z), default=z)))
    extras = []
    if before < a:
        extras.append(("같은 문단 앞", block, before, a, cut(raw, before, a)))
    if z < after:
        extras.append(("같은 문단 뒤", block, z, after, cut(raw, z, after)))
    major = minor = None
    if block.kind == "paragraph":
        for k in sorted((k for k in blocks if k < p), reverse=True):
            item = blocks[k]
            if item.kind != "paragraph" or len(item.text.strip()) > 125:
                continue
            if _MAJOR.match(item.text):
                major = item
                break
            if minor is None and _HEAD.match(item.text):
                minor = item
        for x in (major, minor):
            if x and units(x.text) <= 135:
                extras.append(("앞 절 제목", x, 0, units(x.text), x.text))
        for k, label in ((p - 1, "앞 문단"), (p + 1, "뒤 문단")):
            x = blocks.get(k)
            if x and x.kind == "paragraph" and units(x.text) <= 490 and not _MAJOR.match(x.text):
                extras.append((label, x, 0, units(x.text), x.text))
    return [item for item in extras if item[-1].strip()]


def containing_chunk(candidates, ref, location, block, start, end, quote):
    for candidate in candidates:
        if (
            not candidate.chunk_id
            or candidate.document_id != ref.document_id
            or candidate.extraction_id != location.extraction_id
            or candidate.source_version != ref.source_version
            or candidate.source_file_id != ref.source_file_id
        ):
            continue
        for segment in candidate.segments:
            span = segment.span
            if (
                span.block_order == block.block_order
                and span.source_locator == block.source_locator
                and 0 <= span.start_utf16 <= start < end <= span.end_utf16
                and span.end_utf16 - span.start_utf16 == units(segment.text)
            ):
                try:
                    if cut(segment.text, start - span.start_utf16, end - span.start_utf16) == quote:
                        return candidate.chunk_id
                except UnicodeDecodeError:
                    continue
    return None


def pack(evidence, locations, originals, candidates, budget=CONTEXT_BUDGET):
    groups = []
    chosen = []
    added = set()
    used = 0
    for ref, location, original in zip(evidence, locations, originals, strict=True):
        if original.source != location:
            raise ValueError("Original source identity mismatch")
        groups.append(boosts(ref, original))
        chosen.append([({"id": ref.id, "text": ref.quote}, ref)])
        added.add((location.extraction_id, ref.block_order, ref.start_utf16, ref.end_utf16))
        used += tokens(f"[{ref.id}] {ref.quote}\n\n")
    if used > budget:
        raise ValueError("Selected quotes exceed context budget")

    for j in range(max(map(len, groups), default=0)):
        for i, (ref, location, extras) in enumerate(zip(evidence, locations, groups, strict=True)):
            if j >= len(extras):
                continue
            label, block, start, end, quote = extras[j]
            marker = (location.extraction_id, block.block_order, start, end)
            if marker in added:
                continue
            citation_id = f"{ref.id}.{j + 1}"
            text = f"{label}: {quote}"
            cost = tokens(f"[{citation_id}] {text}\n\n")
            if used + cost > budget:
                continue
            chunk_id = containing_chunk(candidates, ref, location, block, start, end, quote)
            # A nearby original can fall outside the retrieved chunks and have no valid chunkId.
            if chunk_id is None:
                continue
            item = ref.model_copy(
                update={
                    "id": citation_id,
                    "chunk_id": chunk_id,
                    "block_order": block.block_order,
                    "start_utf16": start,
                    "end_utf16": end,
                    "source_locator": block.source_locator,
                    "quote": quote,
                    "relevance": "support",
                }
            )
            chosen[i].append(({"id": citation_id, "text": text}, item))
            added.add(marker)
            used += cost
    pairs = [pair for group in chosen for pair in group]
    return [part for part, _ in pairs], [item for _, item in pairs], used


def source_identity(evidence):
    return evidence.document_id, evidence.source_file_id, evidence.source_version


def verification_input(question, draft, context, evidence, *, prior_user_context=""):
    sources = {}
    passages = [
        {
            **part,
            "source": sources.setdefault(source_identity(e), len(sources) + 1),
            "block": e.block_order,
        }
        for part, e in zip(context, evidence, strict=True)
    ]
    value = {"question": question, "draft": draft, "original_contexts": passages}
    if prior_user_context:
        value["prior_user_context"] = prior_user_context
    return value


class VerificationFailure(ValueError):
    pass


def resolve(draft, audit, evidence, *, coverage=None):
    try:
        audit = AnswerVerification.model_validate(audit)
    except ValidationError:
        raise VerificationFailure("invalid_verification_schema") from None
    try:
        claims = [KnowledgeClaim.model_validate(c) for c in draft["claims"]]
    except (ValidationError, KeyError, TypeError):
        raise VerificationFailure("invalid_claim_schema") from None
    checks = sorted(audit.reviews, key=lambda c: c.index)
    if [c.index for c in checks] != list(range(1, len(claims) + 1)):
        raise VerificationFailure("claim_review_mismatch")

    requirements = {r.id for r in audit.requirements}
    required = {r.id for r in audit.requirements if r.required}
    if (
        not required
        or len(requirements) != len(audit.requirements)
        or any(not r.id.strip() or not r.description.strip() for r in audit.requirements)
    ):
        raise VerificationFailure("invalid_requirements")

    source_by_id = {e.id: source_identity(e) for e in evidence}
    ids = source_by_id.keys()
    kept = []
    findings = []
    fulfilled = set()
    for claim, review in zip(claims, checks, strict=True):
        matches = set(review.requirement_ids)
        cited = set(review.supporting_ids)
        conditions = set(review.condition_evidence_ids)
        if not matches <= requirements:
            raise VerificationFailure("unknown_requirement")

        text = _CITATION_MARKUP.sub("", claim.claim).strip()
        label, reason = review.label, review.reason
        original_ids = set(claim.citations)
        if not text or not original_ids or not original_ids <= ids:
            label, reason = "UNSUPPORTED", "검증된 인용 ID가 없습니다."
        elif not (cited | conditions) <= ids:
            raise VerificationFailure("unknown_evidence")
        elif label == "SUPPORTED" and review.match in {"MATCHED", "PARTIAL_MATCH"}:
            if not cited or not cited <= original_ids or not matches:
                raise VerificationFailure("incomplete_supported_claim")
            same_context = not conditions or (
                review.condition_link == "SAME_CONTEXT"
                and len({source_by_id[ref] for ref in cited | conditions}) == 1
            )
            applicable = review.applicability == "APPLICABLE" and review.scope_basis in {
                "DIRECT",
                "SUPPORTED_TRANSFER",
            }
            condition = review.condition_quote.strip()
            bounded = (
                review.applicability == "CONDITIONAL"
                and review.scope_basis == "BOUNDED"
                and condition
                and condition in text
            )
            if same_context and (applicable or bounded):
                refs = [c for c in dict.fromkeys(claim.citations) if c in cited]
                refs.extend(
                    c for c in dict.fromkeys(review.condition_evidence_ids) if c not in cited
                )
                kept.append(KnowledgeClaim(claim=text, citations=refs))
                if applicable and review.match == "MATCHED":
                    fulfilled.update(matches)
                continue
            label = "UNSUPPORTED"
            scope = review.scope_basis if same_context else "CONDITION_CONTEXT_MISMATCH"
            reason = f"적용 조건 판정 {scope}. {reason}"
        elif label == "SUPPORTED":
            label, reason = "UNSUPPORTED", f"질문 일치 판정 {review.match}. {reason}"
        elif label == "UNCERTAIN":
            label, reason = "UNSUPPORTED", f"원문 지지 판정 UNCERTAIN. {reason}"
        findings.append(ClaimCheck(index=review.index, label=label, reason=reason))

    status: KnowledgeStatus
    if required <= fulfilled and audit.adequate_context:
        status = "answered"
    elif kept:
        status = "partial"
    else:
        status = "insufficient_evidence"

    limits = _CITATION_MARKUP.sub("", draft["limitations"]).strip()
    if audit.limits_unsubstantiated:
        limits = ""
    limit_ids = [ref for ref in dict.fromkeys(draft.get("limitation_citations", [])) if ref in ids]
    if coverage is not None and coverage.scope == "explanation" and not limit_ids:
        # The verified requirements own missing explanation facts; source bounds need citations.
        limits = ""
    if not limits:
        limit_ids = []
        if status == "partial":
            missing = " · ".join(
                _CITATION_MARKUP.sub("", r.description).strip()
                for r in audit.requirements
                if r.required and r.id not in fulfilled
            )
            limits = (
                f"{_PARTIAL} 확인이 필요한 항목은 {missing}입니다."
                if missing
                else "제공된 근거만으로는 전체 질문에 답하기 어렵습니다."
            )
        elif status == "insufficient_evidence":
            limits = _MISSING
    elif limit_ids:
        limits = " ".join([limits, *(f"[{ref}]" for ref in limit_ids)])
    citation_ids = {c for claim in kept for c in claim.citations}
    citation_ids.update(limit_ids)
    if coverage is not None:
        coverage.requirements = [
            RequirementCoverage(
                requirement_id=r.id, description=r.description, fulfilled=r.id in fulfilled
            )
            for r in audit.requirements
            if r.required
        ]
    return KnowledgeReply(
        status=status,
        claims=kept,
        evidence=[e for e in evidence if e.id in citation_ids],
        findings=findings,
        limitations=limits,
    )


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Consultation:
    reply: KnowledgeReply
    trace: dict

    @property
    def answer(self):
        body = [
            " ".join([c.claim, *(f"[{ref}]" for ref in dict.fromkeys(c.citations))])
            for c in self.reply.claims
        ]
        if self.reply.limitations:
            body.append(self.reply.limitations)
        return "\n\n".join(body)


class KnowledgeService:
    def __init__(self, retrieval: KnowledgeClient, model: OpenAIResponses):
        self.retrieval = retrieval
        self.model = model

    async def consult(
        self, question, strategy="large", *, prior_user_context="", delegation_scope="question"
    ):
        start = perf_counter()
        trace = {"model": MODEL, "promptVersion": PROMPT_VERSION, "contextVersion": CONTEXT_VERSION}
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(CONSULTATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS):
                question_input = {"question": question}
                search_question = question
                followup_instructions = (
                    _EXPLANATION_SCOPE if delegation_scope == "explanation" else ""
                )
                trace["delegationScope"] = delegation_scope
                if prior_user_context:
                    trace["usesPriorUserContext"] = True
                    question_input["prior_user_context"] = prior_user_context
                    followup_instructions += _FOLLOWUP_INSTRUCTIONS
                    remaining = SEARCH_QUESTION_LIMIT - len(question) - 1
                    if remaining > 0:
                        search_context = prior_user_context
                        try:
                            parsed = json.loads(prior_user_context)
                            if isinstance(parsed, dict) and isinstance(
                                parsed.get("previous_question"), str
                            ):
                                search_context = parsed["previous_question"]
                        except (ValueError, TypeError):
                            pass
                        search_question += "\n" + search_context[:remaining]
                hits = await self.retrieval.search(search_question, strategy)
                trace["search"] = {
                    "count": len(hits.candidates),
                    "embeddingMs": hits.embedding_ms,
                    "embeddingInputTokens": hits.embedding_input_tokens,
                    "lookupMs": hits.lookup_ms,
                }
                if not hits.candidates:
                    return Consultation(
                        KnowledgeReply(status="insufficient_evidence", limitations=_MISSING), trace
                    )
                bank: dict[str, Candidate] = {f"C{i}": c for i, c in enumerate(hits.candidates, 1)}
                selection = await self.model.run(
                    "select",
                    SELECT + followup_instructions,
                    {
                        **question_input,
                        "candidates": [
                            {
                                "candidate_id": key,
                                "document_id": c.document_id,
                                "paragraph_segments": [
                                    {"paragraph": s.span.block_order, "text": s.text}
                                    for s in c.segments
                                ],
                            }
                            for key, c in bank.items()
                        ],
                    },
                    SELECT_SCHEMA,
                    2500,
                )
                trace["select"] = selection.metrics() | {
                    "sufficiency": selection.content["sufficiency"]
                }  # noqa: E501
                ordered = [item["candidate_id"] for item in selection.content["ranking"]]
                trace["validRanking"] = len(ordered) == len(bank) and set(ordered) == set(bank)
                evidence, locations, rejected = verify_selection(
                    selection.content["evidence"], bank
                )
                trace["rejectedQuotes"] = rejected
                trace["verifiedQuotes"] = len(evidence)
                if not evidence:
                    status = "error" if rejected else "insufficient_evidence"
                    return Consultation(
                        KnowledgeReply(status=status, limitations=_ERROR if rejected else _MISSING),
                        trace,
                    )
                originals = await self.retrieval.context(locations)
                context, citable, used = pack(evidence, locations, originals, hits.candidates)
                trace["contextTokens"] = used
                draft = await self.model.run(
                    "answer",
                    ANSWER + followup_instructions,
                    {**question_input, "evidence": context},
                    ANSWER_SCHEMA,
                    1200,
                )
                trace["answer"] = draft.metrics() | {"rawStatus": draft.content["status"]}
                if (
                    draft.content["status"] == "insufficient"
                    and draft.content["claims"] == []
                    and draft.content["limitation_citations"] == []
                ):
                    trace["detectSkipped"] = "no_claims_or_limitation_citations"
                    return Consultation(
                        KnowledgeReply(status="insufficient_evidence", limitations=_MISSING), trace
                    )
                detection = await self.model.run(
                    "detect",
                    DETECT + followup_instructions,
                    verification_input(
                        question,
                        draft.content,
                        context,
                        citable,
                        prior_user_context=prior_user_context,
                    ),
                    DETECT_SCHEMA,
                    1700,
                )
                trace["detect"] = detection.metrics()
                try:
                    coverage = KnowledgeCoverage(scope=delegation_scope)
                    reply = resolve(draft.content, detection.content, citable, coverage=coverage)
                    trace["coverage"] = coverage.model_dump()
                except VerificationFailure as exc:
                    trace["verificationFailure"] = {
                        "code": str(exc),
                        **{
                            key: len(value) if isinstance(value, list) else None
                            for key, value in (
                                ("claims", draft.content.get("claims")),
                                ("reviews", detection.content.get("reviews")),
                                ("requirements", detection.content.get("requirements")),
                            )
                        },
                        "evidence": len(citable),
                    }
                    raise
                trace["detect"].update(
                    adequateContext=detection.content["adequate_context"],
                    finalStatus=reply.status,
                    keptClaims=len(reply.claims),
                )
                return Consultation(reply, trace)
        except (TimeoutError, UpstreamError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
            trace["error"] = type(exc).__name__
            return Consultation(KnowledgeReply(status="error", limitations=_ERROR), trace)
        finally:
            trace["totalMs"] = round((perf_counter() - start) * 1000)
            logger.info("g5_consult %s", trace)


async def consult_knowledge(
    question, strategy="large", *, prior_user_context="", delegation_scope="question"
):
    settings = get_settings()
    if not settings.g5_openai_api_key or not settings.g5_internal_token:
        return Consultation(KnowledgeReply(status="error", limitations=_ERROR), {})
    async with (
        httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=settings.catalog_api_url.rstrip("/") + "/internal/knowledge/",
            headers={"X-G5-Token": settings.g5_internal_token},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(35, connect=5),
            follow_redirects=False,
        ) as local,
        httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1/",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {settings.g5_openai_api_key}"},
            timeout=httpx.Timeout(45, connect=10),
            follow_redirects=False,
        ) as remote,
    ):
        return await KnowledgeService(KnowledgeClient(local), OpenAIResponses(remote)).consult(
            question,
            strategy,
            prior_user_context=prior_user_context,
            delegation_scope=delegation_scope,
        )

                plan["question"] = ""
            if turn == 3:
                plan["removeKnowledgeIngredients"] = ["글리세린"]
            if turn >= 4:
                plan["goal"]["goals"] = ["sensitivity"]
            if turn in {5, 7}:
                plan["knowledgeAction"] = "clear"

            "지식 조건을 삭제해 줘.",
        ],
        1,
    ):
        if version == 4:
            new_reply = skin_case.resolved_ingredient_reply(monkeypatch, "판테놀")
            consult.return_value = skin_case.Consultation(reply=new_reply, trace={})
            monkeypatch.setattr(skin_case.specialists, "consult_knowledge", consult)
        before = len(downstream.calls)
        payload = {
            "conversationId": room,
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "expectedConversationVersion": version - 1,
            "message": message,
            "locale": "ko",
        }
        response = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=payload)

        detail = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}", headers=AUTH).json()

        expected = {
            1: ["글리세린"],
            2: ["글리세린"],
            3: [],
            4: ["판테놀"],
            5: [],
            6: ["판테놀"],
            7: [],
        }[version]
        assert [c["ingredientName"] for c in state["knowledgeSearch"]["conditions"]] == expected
        assert state["knowledgeSearch"]["source"] == "knowledge"
        calls = downstream.calls[before:]
        assert len([p for p, b in calls if p.endswith("/v4")]) == (1 if version in {1, 4} else 0)
        count = len(downstream.calls)
        model_count = planner.calls + extractor.calls
        replay = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=payload)
        assert replay.status_code == 200
        for field in ("answer", "compound", "knowledge", "conversation"):
            assert replay.json().get(field) == response.json().get(field)
        assert len(downstream.calls) == count and planner.calls + extractor.calls == model_count
        observations.append(
            {
                "turn": version,
                "input": message,
                "httpStatus": response.status_code,
                "storedKnowledgeState": state["knowledgeSearch"],
                "toolHttpRequests": calls,
                "modelConfiguredMode": "mock",
                "actualRemoteModelCalls": 0,
                "mockPlannerCallsCumulative": planner.calls,
                "mockExtractorCallsCumulative": extractor.calls,
                "postgres": "live",
                "api": "mock_transport",
                "replayAdditionalCalls": 0,
            }
        )
    assert consult.await_count == extractor.calls == 3
    record_property("n01_followup_turns", observations)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("g1_enabled", [False, True])

    followup = "각질과 당김이 있어. 로션과 쿠션을 써. 예산은 2만 원이고 향료는 제외해 줘."

        httpx, "AsyncClient", lambda **kw: original(transport=httpx.MockTransport(downstream), **kw)
    )

    class Planner(skin_case.Planner):
        calls = 0
        restored = []

        async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
            if required_tool == "interpret_consultation_change":
                return await super().complete_with_tools(
                    messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
                )
            self.calls += 1
            response, ms = await super().complete_with_tools(
                messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
            )
            if required_tool == "plan_skin_consultation":
                data = json.loads(messages[-1]["content"])
                f = response["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]
                if data["utterance"] == first:
                    plan = {"scope": "consultation", "action": "clarify", "question": question}
                else:
                    assert data["utterance"] == followup
                    self.restored = [(m["role"], m["text"]) for m in data["recentMessages"]]
                    assert ("user", first) in self.restored
                    assert ("assistant", question) in self.restored
                    plan = json.loads(f["arguments"])
                    plan["goal"]["goals"] = ["dryness"]
                    plan["question"] = first + " / " + followup
                f["arguments"] = json.dumps(plan)
            return response, ms

    chat = ChatService(
        None,
        planner,
        CatalogClient("https://api.test"),
        skincare=SkincareRecommendationTool(SkincareRecommendationClient("https://api.test")),

    observations = []
    for version, message in enumerate([first, followup], 1):

            "conversationId": room,
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "expectedConversationVersion": version - 1,
            "message": message,
            "locale": "ko",
        }
        assert "recentMessages" not in payload
        response = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=payload)
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        body = response.json()
        if version == 1:
            assert body["resultType"] == "clarification" and body["answer"] == question
            assert body["products"] == [] and not body.get("compound")
            assert downstream.calls == [] and consult.await_count == 0
        else:
            consult.assert_awaited_once_with(
                first + " / " + followup, delegation_scope="explanation"
            )
            assert body["compound"]["goal"]["goals"] == ["dryness"]
            assert body["compound"]["options"][8]["outcome"] == "eligible"
        counts = (planner.calls, consult.await_count, len(downstream.calls))
        replay = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=payload)
        assert replay.status_code == 200
        assert replay.json()["answer"] == body["answer"]
        assert replay.json().get("compound") == body.get("compound")
        assert counts == (planner.calls, consult.await_count, len(downstream.calls))
        observations.append(
            {
                "turn": version,
                "input": message,
                "answer": body["answer"],
                "clientHistoryProvided": False,
                "modelConfiguredMode": "mock",
                "actualRemoteModelCalls": 0,
                "postgres": "live",
                "catalog": "mock_transport",
                "replayAdditionalCalls": 0,
                "mockCallsCumulative": counts,
            }
        )
    record_property(
        "original_n01_pg",
        {
            "g1Enabled": g1_enabled,
            "turns": observations,
            "serverRestoredHistory": planner.restored,
            "toolRequests": downstream.calls,

@pytest.mark.parametrize("live", [False, True])
def test_execution_control_cancel_replace_pg(api, monkeypatch, record_property, live):
    import asyncio
    from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
    from threading import Event

    from app.clients.llm_client import LlmClient
    from app.services.consultation_parent_graph import run_independent_reads

    if live and os.environ.get("G8_EXECUTION_LIVE") != "1":
        pytest.skip("Explicit live synthetic model cancellation run only")
    client, _ = api
    entered, release = Event(), Event()
    calls, model_calls = [], []
    original_send = httpx.AsyncClient.send

    async def send(http, request, *args, **kwargs):
        if request.url.host == "api.openai.com":
            model_calls.append({"host": request.url.host, "status": None})
            entered.set()
        result = await original_send(http, request, *args, **kwargs)
        if request.url.host == "api.openai.com":
            model_calls[-1]["status"] = result.status_code
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(httpx.AsyncClient, "send", send)

    class ControlledChat:
        async def answer(self, req, principal):
            if req.message == "replacement":
                from app.schemas.consultation_parent import ConsultationParent, ParentTask
                from app.services.consultation_result_service import finalize_result

                response = ChatResponse(answer="replacement result", products=[])
                response._consultation_parent = ConsultationParent(
                    tasks=[ParentTask(goal="product", status="completed", version=1)]
                )
                return finalize_result(response)

            async def first():
                calls.append("first")
                if live:
                    model = LlmClient(
                        os.environ["LLM_BASE_URL"],
                        os.environ["LLM_API_KEY"],
                        os.environ["LLM_MODEL"],
                        60,
                    )
                    reply, _ = await model.complete_with_tools(
                        [{"role": "user", "content": "세안 후 보습 순서를 간단히 설명해줘."}], []
                    )
                    answer = reply["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
                else:
                    entered.set()
                    assert await asyncio.to_thread(release.wait, 20)
                    answer = "late synthetic result"
                return ChatResponse(answer=answer, products=[])

            async def second():
                calls.append("second")
                return ChatResponse(answer="must not run", products=[])

            await run_independent_reads(
                req.message,
                {"knowledge": first, "style": second},
                {},
                check_active=req._g7_execution.check_active,
            )
            return ChatResponse(answer="must not commit", products=[])

    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: ControlledChat()
    room = create(client)[0]["conversationId"]
    request_id = str(uuid4())
    body = {
        "conversationId": room,
        "requestId": request_id,
        "expectedConversationVersion": 0,
        "message": "controlled initial",
        "locale": "en",
    }
    cancel_path = f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{request_id}/cancel"
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as pool:
        pending = pool.submit(client.post, "/api/chat", json=body, headers=AUTH)
        try:
            assert entered.wait(20)
            assert client.post(cancel_path, headers=OTHER).status_code == 404
            cancelled = client.post(cancel_path, headers=AUTH)
            assert cancelled.status_code == 200, cancelled.text
            assert cancelled.json()["status"] == "INTERRUPTED"
            assert cancelled.json()["conversationVersion"] == 0
            assert client.post(cancel_path, headers=AUTH).json() == cancelled.json()
            replacement_id = str(uuid4())
            replacement = client.post(
                "/api/chat",
                headers=AUTH,
                json={**body, "requestId": replacement_id, "message": "replacement"},
            )
            assert replacement.status_code == 200, replacement.text
            assert replacement.json()["conversation"]["version"] == 1
            assert replacement.json()["consultation"]["status"] == "completed"
        finally:
            release.set()
        late = pending.result(timeout=80)
    assert late.status_code == 409 and late.json()["code"] == "request_interrupted"
    assert calls == ["first"]
    assert client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=body).json()["code"] == "request_interrupted"
    committed = client.post(
        f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/requests/{replacement_id}/cancel", headers=AUTH
    )
    assert committed.json()["status"] == "COMMITTED"
    restored = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert [m["text"] for m in restored["messages"]] == ["replacement", "replacement result"]
    assert (
        restored["messages"][-1]["displayPayload"]["consultation"]
        == replacement.json()["consultation"]
    )
    record_property(
        "execution_control",
        json.dumps(
            {
                "modelConfiguredMode": "live" if live else "mock",
                "actualModelHttpCalls": len(model_calls),
                "modelEvents": model_calls,
                "pg": "live",
                "auth": "mock",
                "scheduler": "real parent",
                "specialist": "controlled test",
                "calls": calls,
                "cancelStatus": cancelled.json()["status"],
                "lateStatus": late.status_code,
                "replacementVersion": 1,
                "savedMessages": 2,
            },
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ),
    )

class RecordingChat:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    async def answer(self, request, principal_key):
        self.calls.append(
            {
                "memories": list(request._consented_memories),
                "history": [item.text for item in request.recent_messages],
            }
        )
        return ChatResponse(answer="answer", products=[])

def new_room(client, entry=None):
    result = client.post(
        "/api/chat/conversations",
        headers=AUTH,
        json={
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "entry": entry or {"type": "general"},
        },
    )
    assert result.status_code == 201, result.text
    return result.json()["conversationId"]


def ask(client, room, version, message, request_id=None, *, structured=False, request_type="chat"):
    response = client.post(
        "/api/chat",
        headers=AUTH,
        json={
            "conversationId": room,
            "requestId": request_id or str(uuid4()),
            "expectedConversationVersion": version,
            "locale": "ko",
            "message": message,
            "requestType": request_type,
            **({"structuredMemory": True} if structured else {}),
        },
    )
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def test_previous_fingerprint_schema_replays_and_new_schema_checks_style(memory_api):
    client, chat = memory_api
    room = new_room(client)
    body = {
        "conversationId": room,
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "expectedConversationVersion": 0,
        "locale": "ko",
        "message": "추천 룩 비교해줘",
        "styleSearch": True,
    }
    first = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=body)
    assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
    changed = {
        **body,
        "styleCompare": True,
        "previousStyleCandidates": [{"kind": "video", "lookId": "ST-A"}],
    }
    conflict = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=changed)
    assert (conflict.status_code, conflict.json()["code"]) == (409, "request_conflict")

    owner_id = "user-" + AUTH["Authorization"].removeprefix("Bearer ")
    legacy_hash = ConversationService._request_fingerprint(
        owner_id, ChatRequest.model_validate(changed), legacy=True
    )
    dsn = make_url(URL).set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE chat_turns SET fingerprint = %s, fingerprint_schema = 1 "
            "WHERE owner_id = %s AND request_id = %s",
            (legacy_hash, owner_id, body["requestId"]),
        )
    before = len(chat.calls)
    replay = client.post("/api/chat", headers=AUTH, json=changed)
    assert replay.status_code == 200, replay.text
    assert replay.json() == first.json() and len(chat.calls) == before


def test_consent_ownership_idempotency_and_redaction(memory_api):
    client, chat = memory_api
    room = new_room(client)
    ordinary = ask(client, room, 0, "코랄 립이 좋아요")
    assert ordinary.get("memoryProposal") is None
    assert client.get("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}
    proposal_request_id = str(uuid4())
    proposed = ask(client, room, 1, "코랄 립을 다음에도 기억해줘", proposal_request_id)
    assert "확인" in proposed["answer"] and "기억했" not in proposed["answer"]
    proposal = proposed["memoryProposal"]
    replay = ask(client, room, 1, "코랄 립을 다음에도 기억해줘", proposal_request_id)
    assert replay["memoryProposal"] == proposal
    assert client.get("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}
    body = {
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "proposalId": proposal["proposalId"],
        "expectedProposalVersion": proposal["version"],
        "confirmed": True,
    }
    assert client.post("/api/chat/memories", headers=OTHER, json=body).status_code == 404
    assert (
        client.post(
            "/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH, json={**body, "confirmed": False}
        ).status_code
        == 400
    )
    created = client.post("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH, json=body)
    assert created.status_code == 200, created.text
    assert client.post("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH, json=body).json() == created.json()
    memory_id = created.json()["memoryId"]
    assert len(client.get("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH).json()["memories"]) == 1
    another = new_room(client)
    ask(client, another, 0, "어떤 색이 좋아요?")
    assert "코랄 립을 다음에도 기억해줘" in chat.calls[-1]["memories"]
    state_body = {
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "expectedConversationVersion": 1,
        "operation": "clear_selection",
        "payload": {},
    }
    state_path = f"/api/chat/conversations/{another}/state"
    assert client.patch(state_path, headers=AUTH, json=state_body).status_code == 200
    delete_key = str(uuid4())
    assert (
        client.delete(
            f"/api/chat/memories/{memory_id}", headers={**AUTH, "Idempotency-Key": delete_key}
        ).status_code
        == 204
    )
    assert (
        client.delete(
            f"/api/chat/memories/{memory_id}", headers={**AUTH, "Idempotency-Key": delete_key}
        ).status_code
        == 204
    )
    assert client.get("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}
    replay_deleted = client.post("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH, json=body)
    assert (replay_deleted.status_code, replay_deleted.json()["code"]) == (410, "memory_deleted")
    cannot_reuse = client.post(
        "/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH, json={**body, "requestId": str(uuid4())}
    )
    assert (cannot_reuse.status_code, cannot_reuse.json()["code"]) == (409, "proposal_expired")
    dsn = make_url(URL).set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        value, revoked_at = conn.execute(
            "SELECT value_json, revoked_at FROM chat_memories WHERE id = %s", (memory_id,)
        ).fetchone()
        assert value is None and revoked_at is not None
        columns = conn.execute(
            "SELECT column_name FROM information_schema.columns "
            "WHERE table_name = 'chat_memory_proposals'"
        ).fetchall()
        assert "value_json" not in {column[0] for column in columns}
    assert (
        client.patch(state_path, headers=AUTH, json=state_body).json()["code"]
        == "memory_context_changed"
    )
    status = client.get(
        f"/api/chat/conversations/{another}/requests/{state_body['requestId']}", headers=AUTH
    )
    assert status.status_code == 409 and status.json()["code"] == "memory_context_changed"
    ask(client, room, 2, "다른 조언을 해줘")
    assert chat.calls[-1]["memories"] == []
    assert "코랄 립을 다음에도 기억해줘" not in chat.calls[-1]["history"]
    assert "코랄 립이 좋아요" not in chat.calls[-1]["history"]
    ask(client, another, 2, "다시 설명해줘")
    assert chat.calls[-1]["memories"] == [] and chat.calls[-1]["history"] == []


def test_memory_edit_compare_and_swap_and_proposal_invalidation(memory_api):
    client, chat = memory_api
    room = new_room(client)
    proposal = ask(client, room, 0, "매트 립을 기억해줘")["memoryProposal"]
    body = {
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "proposalId": proposal["proposalId"],
        "expectedProposalVersion": 1,
        "confirmed": True,
    }
    created = client.post("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH, json=body).json()
    memory_id = created["memoryId"]
    pending = ask(client, room, 1, "새틴도 기억해줘")["memoryProposal"]
    another = new_room(client)
    ask(client, another, 0, "기존 취향으로 상담해줘")
    assert "매트 립을 기억해줘" in chat.calls[-1]["memories"]
    edit = {"requestId": str(uuid4()), "expectedVersion": 1, "confirmed": True, "value": "새틴 립"}
    updated = client.patch(f"/api/chat/memories/{memory_id}", headers=AUTH, json=edit)
    assert updated.status_code == 200 and updated.json()["memoryVersion"] == 2
    ask(client, another, 1, "다시 추천해줘")
    assert chat.calls[-1]["memories"] == ["새틴 립"]
    assert chat.calls[-1]["history"] == []
    assert (
        client.patch(f"/api/chat/memories/{memory_id}", headers=AUTH, json=edit).json()
        == updated.json()
    )
    stale = client.patch(
        f"/api/chat/memories/{memory_id}", headers=AUTH, json={**edit, "requestId": str(uuid4())}
    )
    assert (stale.status_code, stale.json()["code"]) == (409, "memory_conflict")
    invalid = client.post(
        "/api/chat/memories",
        headers=AUTH,
        json={
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "proposalId": pending["proposalId"],
            "expectedProposalVersion": 1,
            "confirmed": True,
        },
    )
    assert (invalid.status_code, invalid.json()["code"]) == (409, "proposal_expired")

def test_proposal_has_exactly_fifteen_minutes_and_expires_at_boundary(memory_api, monkeypatch):
    client, _ = memory_api
    room = new_room(client)
    request_id = str(uuid4())
    text = "코랄 립을 기억해줘"
    proposal = ask(client, room, 0, text, request_id)["memoryProposal"]
    dsn = make_url(URL).set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        issued_at, expires_at = conn.execute(
            "SELECT created_at, expires_at FROM chat_memory_proposals WHERE id = %s",
            (proposal["proposalId"],),
        ).fetchone()
    assert expires_at - issued_at == timedelta(minutes=15)

    clock = Mock()
    monkeypatch.setattr(memory_service, "datetime", clock)
    clock.now.return_value = expires_at - timedelta(microseconds=1)
    assert ask(client, room, 0, text, request_id)["memoryProposal"] == proposal

    clock.now.return_value = expires_at
    assert ask(client, room, 0, text, request_id).get("memoryProposal") is None
    response = client.post(
        "/api/chat/memories",
        headers=AUTH,
        json={
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "proposalId": proposal["proposalId"],
            "expectedProposalVersion": 1,
            "confirmed": True,
        },
    )
    assert (response.status_code, response.json()["code"]) == (409, "proposal_expired")
    assert client.get("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}


def test_structured_memory_partial_approval_preserves_versions_and_sources(memory_api, monkeypatch):
    client, chat = memory_api
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g7_structured_memory_enabled", True)
    room = new_room(client)
    source = (
        "나는 건성이야, 출근할 때 코랄 립을 좋아하고, "
        "매트 베이스를 선호하고, A 파운데이션을 갖고 있어, 기억해줘"
    )
    asked = ask(client, room, 0, source, structured=True)
    assert asked.get("memoryProposal") is None
    assert len(chat.calls) == 1
    path = "/api/chat/v2/memory-proposals"
    params = {"conversationId": room}
    assert client.get(path, headers=OTHER, params=params).status_code == 404
    (group,) = client.get(path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json()
    items = {item["key"]: item for item in group["items"]}
    assert set(items) == {"skin.type", "makeup.color", "makeup.finish", "inventory.product"}
    assert items["makeup.color"]["value"] == {"area": "lip", "family": "coral"}
    assert items["makeup.color"]["context"] == "work"
    assert items["inventory.product"]["value"] == {"productName": "A 파운데이션"}
    group_path = f"{path}/{group['groupId']}"
    color = items["makeup.color"]
    edit = {"requestId": str(uuid4()), "expectedVersion": color["version"], "value": "pink"}
    edited = client.patch(f"{group_path}/{color['itemId']}", headers=AUTH, json=edit)
    assert edited.status_code == 200, edited.text
    assert edited.json()["value"] == {"area": "lip", "family": "pink"}
    assert (
        client.patch(f"{group_path}/{color['itemId']}", headers=AUTH, json=edit).json()
        == edited.json()
    )

    def decision(item, action="approve"):
        return {
            "itemId": item["itemId"],
            "expectedVersion": item["version"],
            "action": action,
            **({"confirmed": True} if action == "approve" else {}),
        }

    decisions_path = f"{group_path}/decisions"
    stale = {
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "decisions": [decision(items["skin.type"]), decision(color)],
    }
    assert client.post(decisions_path, headers=AUTH, json=stale).status_code == 409
    assert client.get("/api/chat/v2/memories", headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}
    body = {
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "decisions": [
            decision(items["skin.type"]),
            decision(edited.json()),
            decision(items["makeup.finish"], "reject"),
            decision(items["inventory.product"], "defer"),
        ],
    }
    assert client.post(decisions_path, headers=OTHER, json=body).status_code == 404
    approved = client.post(decisions_path, headers=AUTH, json=body)
    assert approved.status_code == 200, approved.text
    assert client.post(decisions_path, headers=AUTH, json=body).json() == approved.json()
    (open_group,) = client.get(path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json()
    assert open_group["expiresAt"] == group["expiresAt"]
    assert [(item["key"], item["status"]) for item in open_group["items"]] == [
        ("inventory.product", "deferred")
    ]

    assert client.get("/api/chat/memories", headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}
    listed = client.get("/api/chat/v2/memories", headers=AUTH).json()["memories"]
    assert {item["key"] for item in listed} == {"skin.type", "makeup.color"}
    color_id = next(item["id"] for item in listed if item["key"] == "makeup.color")
    dsn = make_url(URL).set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        assert conn.execute(
            "SELECT count(message_id), count(edit_request_id) FROM chat_memory_sources "
            "WHERE memory_id = %s",
            (color_id,),
        ).fetchone() == (1, 1)
        assert conn.execute(
            "SELECT expires_at - created_at FROM chat_memory_proposal_groups WHERE id = %s",
            (group["groupId"],),
        ).fetchone() == (timedelta(minutes=15),)
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM chat_messages WHERE conversation_id = %s", (room,))
    assert client.get(path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json() == []
    assert client.get("/api/chat/v2/memories", headers=AUTH).json()["memories"] == listed
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        assert conn.execute(
            "SELECT count(message_id) FROM chat_memory_sources WHERE memory_id = %s",
            (color_id,),
        ).fetchone() == (0,)
    delete_headers = {**AUTH, "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid4())}
    assert (
        client.delete(f"/api/chat/memories/{color_id}", headers=delete_headers).status_code == 404
    )
    assert (
        client.delete(f"/api/chat/v2/memories/{color_id}", headers=delete_headers).status_code
        == 204
    )

def test_structured_skin_replacement_and_second_decision_use_latest_versions(
    memory_api, monkeypatch
):
    client, _ = memory_api
    monkeypatch.setattr(get_settings(), "g7_structured_memory_enabled", True)
    room = new_room(client)
    path = "/api/chat/v2/memory-proposals"
    params = {"conversationId": room}

    def current_group():
        (group,) = client.get(path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json()
        return group

    def approve(group, key):
        item = next(item for item in group["items"] if item["key"] == key)
        response = client.post(
            f"{path}/{group['groupId']}/decisions",
            headers=AUTH,
            json={
                "requestId": str(uuid4()),
                "decisions": [
                    {
                        "itemId": item["itemId"],
                        "expectedVersion": item["version"],
                        "action": "approve",
                        "confirmed": True,
                    }
                ],
            },
        )
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        return response.json()["items"][0]

    ask(client, room, 0, "내 피부 타입은 건성이야, 기억해줘", structured=True)
    first = approve(current_group(), "skin.type")
    ask(
        client,
        room,
        1,
        "내 피부 타입은 지성이야, 매트 베이스를 선호해, B 파운데이션을 갖고 있어, 기억해줘",
        structured=True,
    )
    group = current_group()
    changed_skin = next(item for item in group["items"] if item["key"] == "skin.type")
    assert changed_skin["previousDisplayValue"] == "건성"
    saved = approve(group, "skin.type")
    assert saved["memoryId"] == first["memoryId"] and saved["memoryVersion"] == 2
    approve(current_group(), "makeup.finish")
    approve(current_group(), "inventory.product")
    assert client.get(path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json() == []
    memories = client.get("/api/chat/v2/memories", headers=AUTH).json()["memories"]
    assert {memory["key"]: memory["value"] for memory in memories} == {
        "skin.type": "지성",
        "makeup.finish": "베이스 · 매트",
        "inventory.product": "B 파운데이션 (상품 미확인)",
    }

def test_memory_policy_and_catalog_application_end_to_end(memory_api, monkeypatch):

    memories_path = "/api/chat/v2/memories"

    params = {"conversationId": room}

    def settings():
        response = client.get(settings_path, headers=AUTH)
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        return response.json()

    def mode(enabled):
        response = client.patch(
            settings_path,
            headers=AUTH,
            json={
                "requestId": str(uuid4()),
                "expectedVersion": settings()["version"],
                "enabled": enabled,
                "acknowledgeNotice": True,
            },
        )

    def approve(group):
        return client.post(
            f"{groups_path}/{group['groupId']}/decisions",
            headers=AUTH,
            json={
                "requestId": str(uuid4()),
                "decisions": [
                    {
                        "itemId": item["itemId"],
                        "expectedVersion": item["version"],
                        "action": "approve",
                        "confirmed": True,
                    }
                    for item in group["items"]
                ],
            },
        )

    initial = settings()
    assert initial["enabled"] and not initial["noticeAcknowledged"]
    ask(client, room, 0, "나는 매트 립을 선호해, 기억해줘", structured=True)
    (group,) = client.get(groups_path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json()
    approved = approve(group)
    assert approved.status_code == 200, approved.text
    memory_id = approved.json()["items"][0]["memoryId"]
    original = "  코랄 립을 기억해줘  "
    legacy = ask(client, room, 1, original)["memoryProposal"]
    created = client.post(
        "/api/chat/memories",
        headers=AUTH,
        json={
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "proposalId": legacy["proposalId"],
            "expectedProposalVersion": legacy["version"],
            "confirmed": True,
        },
    )
    assert created.status_code == 200, created.text
    original_id = created.json()["memoryId"]
    ask(client, room, 2, "나는 건성이야, 기억해줘", structured=True)
    (pending,) = client.get(groups_path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json()

    class PromptChat:
        async def answer(self, request, principal_key):
            prompt = build_messages(request, [])[0]["content"]
            assert original in prompt
            assert "makeup.finish" in prompt
            assert "건성이야" not in prompt
            return ChatResponse(answer="관련 상담 답변", products=[])

    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = PromptChat
    prompt_room = new_room(client)
    answer = ask(client, prompt_room, 0, "립 마무리 방법이 궁금해", structured=True)
    assert "appliedMemories" not in answer
    dsn = make_url(URL).set(drivername="postgresql").render_as_string(hide_password=False)
    with psycopg.connect(dsn) as conn:
        (refs,) = conn.execute(
            "SELECT memory_refs FROM chat_messages "
            "WHERE conversation_id = %s AND role = 'assistant'",
            (prompt_room,),
        ).fetchone()
        assert {item["memoryId"] for item in refs} == {original_id, memory_id}

    catalog = Catalog()
    catalog.products[0].texture = "glossy"
    llm = PlanLlm(intent="search", category="lip", maxPriceKRW=20000)
    service = ChatService(None, llm, catalog)
    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: service
    target = new_room(client)
    query = "2만원 이하 립 추천해줘"
    rid = str(uuid4())
    first = ask(client, target, 0, query, rid, structured=True, request_type="beauty_consultation")
    assert [p["id"] for p in first["products"]] == ["b", "a"]
    assert first["appliedMemories"] == [
        {
            "memoryId": memory_id,
            "version": 1,
            "key": "makeup.finish",
            "tool": "catalog.search_products",
            "field": "texture",
            "applicationKind": "ranking",
        }
    ]
    assert original not in str(llm.messages)
    ignored = ask(
        client,
        target,
        1,
        "기억 반영하지 말고 2만원 이하 립 추천해줘",
        structured=True,
        request_type="beauty_consultation",
    )
    assert [p["id"] for p in ignored["products"]] == ["a", "b"]
    assert "appliedMemories" not in ignored
    explicit = ask(
        client,
        target,
        2,
        "글로시한 2만원 이하 립 추천해줘",
        structured=True,
        request_type="beauty_consultation",
    )
    assert "appliedMemories" not in explicit

    disabled = mode(False)
    assert not disabled["enabled"] and disabled["noticeAcknowledged"]
    assert len(client.get(memories_path, headers=AUTH).json()["memories"]) == 2
    patch = client.patch(
        f"{memories_path}/{memory_id}",
        headers=AUTH,
        json={
            "requestId": str(uuid4()),
            "expectedVersion": 1,
            "confirmed": True,
            "value": "satin",
            "locale": "ko",
        },
    )
    assert patch.status_code == 200 and patch.json()["version"] == 2
    off = ask(client, target, 3, query, structured=True, request_type="beauty_consultation")
    assert [p["id"] for p in off["products"]] == ["a", "b"] and "appliedMemories" not in off
    replay = ask(client, target, 0, query, rid, structured=True, request_type="beauty_consultation")
    assert "appliedMemories" not in replay
    blocked = approve(pending)
    assert blocked.status_code == 409 and blocked.json()["code"] == "memory_disabled"
    assert mode(True)["enabled"]
    assert client.get(groups_path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json() == []
    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: chat
    ask(client, room, 3, "치크는 코랄을 좋아해, 기억해줘", structured=True)
    (to_clear,) = client.get(groups_path, headers=AUTH, params=params).json()
    before = settings()
    clear = {
        "requestId": str(uuid4()),
        "expectedVersion": before["version"],
        "expectedMemorySetRevision": before["memorySetRevision"],
        "confirmed": True,
    }
    deleted = client.post(f"{memories_path}/delete-all", headers=AUTH, json=clear)
    assert deleted.status_code == 200 and deleted.json()["enabled"]
    assert (
        client.post(f"{memories_path}/delete-all", headers=AUTH, json=clear).json()
        == deleted.json()
    )
    assert client.get(memories_path, headers=AUTH).json() == {"memories": []}
    blocked = approve(to_clear)
    assert blocked.status_code == 409 and blocked.json()["code"] == "memory_proposal_changed"
    detail = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{target}", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert len(detail["messages"]) == 8
    assert all("appliedMemories" not in item["displayPayload"] for item in detail["messages"])


class SkincareHttpFixture:

        self.unmatched_option = False

        if request.url.path == "/api/products":
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"products": list(self.products.values())})
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        if request.url.path == "/api/recommendations/skincare/v4":
            self.v4_calls.append(body)
            if self.unavailable:
                return httpx.Response(503, json={})
            goal = body["detectedConcerns"][0]["goal"]
            profile_goal = {"dry": "dryness", "oily": "oiliness"}[body["skinType"]]

                {
                    "product": item,

                    "optionName": name,
                    "priceKRW": item["priceKRW"],
                    "reasons": [
                        {
                            "goal": reason_goal,
                            "sources": (["conversation"] if reason_goal == goal else [])
                            + (["skinProfile"] if reason_goal == profile_goal else []),
                            "ingredientCodes": ["fixture-humectant"],
                            "evidenceLevel": "ingredient_presence",
                            "evidenceSources": ["cosing_function"],
                        }
                        for reason_goal in dict.fromkeys((goal, profile_goal))
                    ],
                }
                for name, item in self.products.items()
            ]
            groups = {
                key: matches if key in {goal, profile_goal} else [] for key in get_args(SkinGoal)
            }
            return httpx.Response(
                200,
                json={
                    "strategyVersion": "skincare-v4",
                    "dataVersion": "fixture-v1",
                    "overallTop5": matches,
                    "overallTop10": matches,
                    "byConcern": groups,
                    "coverage": [
                        {"goal": goal, "status": "ok" if rows else "no_matches"}
                        for goal, rows in groups.items()
                    ],
                },
            )
        assert request.url.path == "/api/catalog/options/search"
        self.option_calls.append(body)
        stamp = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()

            name = scope["productId"]

            amount = self.products[name]["priceKRW"]
            source = {"sourceVersion": "fixture-v1", "sourceRef": "https://example.test/option"}
            checks = [{"condition": "identity", "verdict": "MATCH", "reason": "exact", **source}]
            price = None
            if body["maxPriceKRW"] is not None:
                checks.append(
                    {
                        "condition": "price",
                        "verdict": "MATCH" if amount <= body["maxPriceKRW"] else "NOT_MATCH",
                        "reason": "reference_price",
                        **source,
                    }
                )
                price = {
                    "requestedBasis": body["priceBasis"],
                    "observedBasis": "catalog_reference",
                    "amountKRW": amount,
                    "checkedAt": stamp,
                    **source,
                }
            for condition in body["ingredientConditions"]:
                present = name == "fragrance"
                checks.append(
                    {
                        "condition": "ingredient",
                        **condition,
                        "verdict": "NOT_MATCH" if present else "MATCH",
                        "reason": "ingredient_present" if present else "ingredient_absent",
                        "evidenceId": name + "-ingredients",
                        "reviewStatus": "verified",
                        "observedAt": stamp,
                        "ingredientCoverage": "full",
                        "normalizationStatus": "verified",
                        **source,
                    }
                )
            items.append(
                {
                    **scope,
                    **({"optionId": "unmatched"} if self.unmatched_option else {}),
                    "sourceVersion": "fixture-v1",
                    "checks": checks,
                    "price": price,
                    "group": "EXCLUDED"
                    if any(c["verdict"] == "NOT_MATCH" for c in checks)
                    else "ELIGIBLE",
                }
            )
        visible = [self.products[i["productId"]] for i in items if i["group"] == "ELIGIBLE"]
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "effectiveRequest": body,
                "checkedAt": stamp,
                "status": "SUCCESS",
                "items": items,
                "products": visible,
                "excludedCount": len(items) - len(visible),

                    "unidentifiedOptions": 0,
                    "exhaustive": True,
                    "stoppedReason": "COMPLETE",
                    "errors": 0,
                },
            },

def test_added_same_role_task_ids_pg_restore_and_targeted_retry(memory_api, monkeypatch):
    from app.core.errors import UpstreamError
    from app.services import chat_service
    from tests.test_g8_consultation_intent import AdditionModel, knowledge_result
    from tests.test_g8_partial_success import Catalog, CombinedModel

    catalog, observed, calls = Catalog(failures=0), [], []
    q1, q2 = "세안 후 보습 순서를 설명해줘", "자외선 차단제를 덧바르는 방법도 설명해줘"
    failing = True

    async def knowledge(question):
        calls.append(question)
        if question == q2 and failing:
            raise UpstreamError("synthetic knowledge failure")
        return knowledge_result(question, 1 if question == q1 else 2)

    monkeypatch.setattr(chat_service, "consult_knowledge", knowledge)

    class Observed(ChatService):
        async def answer(self, req, principal_key=None):
            result = await super().answer(req, principal_key)
            observed.append(result)
            return result

    service = Observed(FakeGraph(), CombinedModel(), catalog)
    client.app.dependency_overrides[get_chat_service] = lambda: service
    room, version = new_room(client), 0
    for operation, payload in [
        ("select_product", {"productId": "product-a"}),
        ("select_look", {"kind": "catalog", "lookId": "daily"}),
    ]:
        changed = client.patch(
            f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}/state",
            headers=AUTH,
            json={
                "requestId": str(uuid4()),
                "expectedConversationVersion": version,
                "operation": operation,
                "payload": payload,
            },
        )
        assert changed.status_code == 200
        version = changed.json()["conversationVersion"]
    first = ask(
        client,
        room,
        version,
        '"상품나"와 브랜드 비교하고 비슷한 룩도 찾아줘',
        request_type="beauty_consultation",
    )
    service._llm = AdditionModel([{"capability": "knowledge", "quote": q} for q in [q1, q2]])
    added = ask(
        client,
        room,
        first["conversation"]["version"],
        q1 + ". " + q2,
        request_type="beauty_consultation",
    )
    task_ids = [t.task_id for t in observed[-1]._consultation_parent.tasks if t.goal == "knowledge"]
    assert len(task_ids) == 2 and calls == [q1, q2]

        "completed",
        "failed",
    ]
    failing = False
    service._llm = AdditionModel(action="retry", targets=[task_ids[1]])
    recovered = ask(
        client,
        room,
        added["conversation"]["version"],
        "덧바르는 방법만 다시 설명해줘",
        request_type="beauty_consultation",
    )
    assert calls == [q1, q2, q2]
    assert [
        t.task_id for t in observed[-1]._consultation_parent.tasks if t.goal == "knowledge"
    ] == task_ids
    records = {r.task_id: r for r in observed[-1]._task_results}
    assert records[task_ids[0]].reused and records[task_ids[0]].attempt == 0
    assert [e["documentId"] for e in recovered["knowledge"]["evidence"]] == [1, 2]
    restored = client.get(f"/api/chat/conversations/{room}", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert restored["messages"][-1]["text"] == recovered["answer"]

class SkinApi:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.options = [f"sale-{rank}" for rank in range(1, 11)]
        self.fail_ids = set()

    def __call__(self, request):
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        path = request.url.path
        self.calls.append((path, body))
        rows = []
        for rank, option_id in enumerate(self.options, 1):
            row = match(body["detectedConcerns"][0]["goal"] if path.endswith("/v4") else "pores")
            row["product"].update(id=f"p{rank}", nameKo=f"시험 상품 {rank}")
            if rank == 9:
                row["product"].update(brand="예시랩", nameKo="데일리 보습 로션")
            row.update(optionId=option_id, optionName=f"{rank * 10}ml")
            rows.append(row)
        if path == "/api/recommendations/skincare/v4":
            return httpx.Response(
                200, json=payload(tuple(c["goal"] for c in body["detectedConcerns"]), matches=rows)
            )
        assert path == "/api/catalog/options/search"
        if set(body["productIds"]) & self.fail_ids:
            return httpx.Response(503)
        items, products = [], []
        for scope in body["optionScope"]:
            rank = int(scope["productId"][1:])
            # The source contains one confirmed option at rank 9 and one partial label at rank 3.
            amount = 18500
            present = rank != 9
            label_unknown = rank == 3
            source = {"sourceRef": "https://example.test/label", "sourceVersion": "fixture-label"}
            checks = [{"condition": "identity", "verdict": "MATCH", "reason": "exact", **source}]
            price_ok = amount <= body["maxPriceKRW"]
            checks.append(
                {
                    "condition": "price",
                    "verdict": "MATCH" if price_ok else "NOT_MATCH",
                    "reason": "snapshot_price",
                }
            )
            checks.append(
                {
                    "condition": "ingredient",
                    "ingredientName": "향료",
                    "operator": "excludes",
                    "verdict": "UNKNOWN" if label_unknown else "NOT_MATCH" if present else "MATCH",
                    "reason": "absence_not_verifiable"
                    if label_unknown
                    else ("ingredient_present" if present else "ingredient_absent"),
                    "evidenceId": f"label-{rank}",
                    "observedAt": STAMP,
                    "reviewStatus": "verified",
                    "normalizationStatus": "verified",
                    "ingredientCoverage": "partial" if label_unknown else "full",
                    **source,
                }
            )
            checks.extend(
                {
                    "condition": "ingredient",
                    "ingredientName": condition["ingredientName"],
                    "operator": condition["operator"],
                    "verdict": "MATCH",
                    "reason": "ingredient_present"
                    if condition["operator"] == "includes"
                    else "ingredient_absent",
                    "evidenceId": f"label-{rank}",
                    "observedAt": STAMP,
                    "reviewStatus": "verified",
                    "normalizationStatus": "verified",
                    "ingredientCoverage": "full",
                    **source,
                }
                for condition in body["ingredientConditions"]
                if condition["ingredientName"] != "향료"
            )
            group = (
                "EXCLUDED"
                if not price_ok or present and not label_unknown
                else ("REFERENCE_ONLY" if label_unknown else "ELIGIBLE")
            )
            items.append(
                {
                    **scope,
                    "sourceVersion": "fixture-label",
                    "group": group,
                    "checks": checks,
                    "price": {
                        "amountKRW": amount,
                        "requestedBasis": body["priceBasis"],
                        "observedBasis": "collected_snapshot",
                        "observedAt": STAMP,
                        "checkedAt": STAMP,
                        **source,
                    },
                }
            )
            if group != "EXCLUDED":
                products.append(rows[rank - 1]["product"])
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "effectiveRequest": body,
                "checkedAt": STAMP,
                "status": "PARTIAL"
                if any(i["group"] == "REFERENCE_ONLY" for i in items)
                else "SUCCESS",
                "items": items,
                "products": products,
                "checkedScope": {
                    "candidateProducts": len(items),
                    "candidateOptions": len(items),
                    "checkedOptions": len(items),
                    "unidentifiedOptions": 0,
                    "exhaustive": True,
                    "stoppedReason": "COMPLETE",
                    "errors": 0,
                },
                "excludedCount": sum(i["group"] == "EXCLUDED" for i in items),
                "omittedCount": 0,
            },
        )

class Planner:
    configured = True

    async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
        if required_tool in {"interpret_consultation_change", "plan_consultation_entry"}:
            state = json.loads(messages[-1]["content"])
            args = {"planId": state["planId"], "version": state["version"], "action": "continue"}
            return {
                "choices": [
                    {
                        "message": {
                            "tool_calls": [
                                {
                                    "function": {
                                        "name": required_tool,
                                        "arguments": json.dumps(args),
                                    }
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }, 0
        if required_tool == "extract_knowledge_search_conditions":
            return {
                "choices": [
                    {
                        "message": {
                            "tool_calls": [
                                {
                                    "function": {
                                        "name": required_tool,
                                        "arguments": '{"conditions":[]}',
                                    }
                                }
                            ]
                        }
                    }
                ]
            }, 0
        assert required_tool == "plan_skin_consultation"
        decision = {
            "scope": "consultation",
            "action": "start",
            "goal": GOAL.model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True),
            "question": CARE_QUESTION,
        }
        call = {
            "type": "function",
            "id": "plan-1",
            "function": {
                "name": required_tool,
                "arguments": json.dumps(decision),
            },
        }
        return {"choices": [{"finish_reason": "tool_calls", "message": {"tool_calls": [call]}}]}, 0

def test_binding_rejects_invalid_plan_and_late_result():
    binding = InputBinding(source_task="P1")
    base = {"goal": GOAL, "plan_id": uuid4(), "plan_version": 2}
    product = TaskRequest(**base, task_id="P1", agent="recommend")
    verify = TaskRequest(
        **base, task_id="V1", agent="verify", depends_on=["P1"], input_bindings=[binding]
    )
    assert graph.validate_plan([verify, product]) == ["P1", "V1"]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unresolved dependency"):
        graph.validate_plan([verify])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        graph.validate_plan([product.model_copy(update={"depends_on": ["V1"]}), verify])
    late = TaskResult(
        task_id="P1",
        plan_id=product.plan_id,
        plan_version=1,
        input_fingerprint="old",
        status="complete",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Stale specialist result"):
        graph.bound_candidates(verify, binding, late)

        async def complete_with_tools(self, messages, tools, *, required_tool=None):
            reply, usage = await super().complete_with_tools(
                messages, tools, required_tool=required_tool
            )
            if required_tool == "plan_skin_consultation":
                self.turn += 1
                function = reply["choices"][0]["message"]["tool_calls"][0]["function"]
                decision = json.loads(function["arguments"])
                if self.turn > 1:
                    decision["action"] = "refine"
                    decision["goal"].update(
                        goals=["sensitivity"],
                        wantsProducts=self.turn == 3,
                        wantsKnowledge=self.turn == 2,
                    )
                    decision["question"] = "민감함 관리 방법은?" if self.turn == 2 else ""
                function["arguments"] = json.dumps(decision)
            return reply, usage

    chat = ChatService(None, TurnPlanner(), catalog, skincare=skincare)
    saved = {}
    for turn, utterance in enumerate(
        [QUESTION, "모공 말고 민감함 관리 방법만 설명해 줘.", "그 목표로 제품을 다시 추천해 줘."], 1
    ):
        request = ChatRequest(message=utterance, locale="ko")
        request._compound_context = read_context(saved).compound
        response = await chat.answer(request)
        assert response.compound is not None
        saved = updated_context(saved, response)
        restored = read_context(saved).compound
        if turn == 2:
            assert restored.candidates == [] and restored.candidate_goals is None
    calls = [body for path, body in api.calls if path.endswith("/v4")]
    assert len(calls) == 2
    assert calls[-1]["detectedConcerns"] == [{"goal": "sensitivity", "sources": ["conversation"]}]
